annotations.text:
TWO DESIGNS NOW, NOT ONE THAT SQUEEZES.

The phone is laid out for a phone. A profile header with your photo, name and role as one block. Numbers on a rail you flick. Work as swipeable cards with the next one peeking, instead of six stacked. Years scroll sideways. And a bar pinned at the bottom with Email me on it, so nobody has to scroll back up to find you.

It comes out at 4,557px against 9,120px for the reflowed version. Same words, half the scrolling.

Expand either artboard to use it properly.

THE WORDS STAY IN ONE PLACE.

Two layouts would normally mean two copies of the text that drift apart. Main owns the data; tools/sync-phone-data.cjs lifts it into the phone file. Verified byte-identical.

Edit Main, run the script, re-seed.

STILL OPEN: your photo, and the real months for Express Scripts and Bank of America.
